text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaa~~~h! Cute Curren Chaaaaaaan!!

Today, an open training session is being 
held as part of the academy's PR 
activities. Curren Chan is as popular as 
ever, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they said the academy was open to the 
public so I came in, but I still don't 
really get it...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Me too~ I don't really watch races anyway. 
Let's just go home already~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...Ehe♪ Deciiided!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother! Can we switch the menu around 
just a bit? I wanna do the 30 dashes of 
doom right now♪
choice_data_list: So you've got a plan, huh?
So you have something in mind, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis! Can we switch up the order of the 
menu a teeny bit? I wanna do the 30 hell 
dashes right now♪
choice_data_list: So you've got a plan, huh?
So you have something in mind, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! We let people freely film our 
training... and then after that—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Curren's 30-Dash Challenge!" Let's 
start~~☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh~! Go for it, Curren~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, isn't that super hyped up!? Wait, 
she's so fast!! Insane~...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Finished the whole run~~! 
Target time cleared! Challenge a huge 
success☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, it's all thanks to everyone cheering 
for me♪ Kyururu~n☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Even after sprinting like that... Her 
smile is pure angel...!! It's already 
trending on UmaStagram too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah♪ Could it be that you guys were 
cheering for Curren too?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, well... Um, she sure is fast...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe☆ Thank you♪ If you're ever 
interested in Umamusume races, I'd love 
for you to check out Curren too~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know! To commemorate our meeting here... 
Here, shake my hand♪ *Squeeeeze!*

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
C-Cute...! Do girls this cute really run 
in races?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Curren Chan...! C-Can I shake 
your hand too!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's so cool~! I wanna shake hands 
too...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm so glad♪ ...Actually, it was 
supposed to be a surprise, but Curren 
really, you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to hold a handshake event 
with everyone at the end! Everyone, will 
you... shake hands with Curren?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Is that true~~?! I wanna, I wanna~! I love 
you, Curren~~~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll wrap up practice early and do 
my best so I can shake hands with 
everyone! Cheer for me, okay~☆"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa~~h! Yay~~!! Cute! Cute Curren 
Chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, longtime fans will be even happier 
if you tease them just a little bit...♪

It seems it was all calculated...! And 
thus, Curren Chan gained new fans while 
leaving her existing ones head over heels!
